How to Download Bilibili Videos on PC & Mac

Updated for 2026 • 3 Min Read • Tested on Windows 11 & macOS Sonoma

Downloading content from Bilibili on a desktop computer gives you the highest fidelity video experience. Whether you want to archive tutorials, anime episodes, or gaming commentary, follow these simple steps to save files directly.

Step 1: Obtain the Bilibili Video URL

Open your preferred browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari) and navigate to the Bilibili video page. You can copy the URL directly from your browser's address bar (e.g. https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1...) or click the Share icon beneath the video player and choose Copy Link.

Step 2: Enter the Link on BiliExtract

Head over to BiliExtract.com. Paste your link into the primary search bar at the top of the page. Click the orange Download Now button.

Step 3: Pick Your Resolution and Download

Our extractor inspects the video manifest in real-time. In the results table:

  • For Video: Click the Download MP4 button next to 1080P Full HD or 720P HD.
  • For Audio Only: Switch to the Audio tab and download 320 kbps MP3.
Pro-Tip for Fast Downloads: If your browser opens the video in a new tab instead of immediately downloading, right-click the video and select "Save Video As..." to store it on your drive.
